items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: HT Co. Becomes Largest Shareholder of Japan Material Co., Ltd.
items.summary: HT Co. has become the largest shareholder of Japan Material Co., Ltd. following a transfer of 5 million shares from Chairman and Representative Director Hisao Tanaka.

items.headline: BTIG Raises Price Target for SBC Medical Group
items.summary: BTIG has increased its price target for SBC Medical Group Holdings Inc. from $8.00 to $10.00 per share while maintaining a Buy rating.

items.headline: Aker Solutions Receives Letter of Intent to Dismantle Equinor's Statfjord Platform
items.summary: Aker Solutions has been issued a letter of intent by Equinor to handle the dismantling of the Statfjord platform.

items.headline: CMB.TECH Announces Rescheduled Q3 2026 Earnings Release Date
items.summary: CMB.TECH NV has postponed its third-quarter 2026 earnings release to November 24, 2026, to better align with the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday schedule.

items.headline: Deutsche Bank Economists Raise US Neutral Interest Rate Forecast
items.summary: Deutsche Bank economists have increased their estimate for the nominal neutral US interest rate by 25 basis points following October consumer price data.

items.headline: Deutsche Bank Reports Major Internal Data Leak
items.summary: Deutsche Bank is facing reports of a significant data leak involving over 15 million internal documents, including emails and reports.

items.headline: Thomas Saueressig Appointed as New CEO of IONOS Group SE
items.summary: IONOS Group SE has announced that Thomas Saueressig will succeed Achim Weiss as CEO, effective April 1, 2027.

items.headline: Mercedes-Benz Vietnam Announces 'The Icons, Electrified' Pop-Up Event in Hanoi
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz Vietnam is hosting a pop-up exhibition at Lotte Mall Hanoi from November 26 to 29, 2026, featuring electric vehicle models including the GLC 350 e 4MATIC, E 350 e, and CLA 200 electric.

items.headline: DEME Group NV Reports Q3 2026 Trading Update
items.summary: DEME Group NV announced its third-quarter 2026 trading update, reporting a 6% year-on-year increase in nine-month turnover to over 3.2 billion euros.

items.headline: Advantest Announces V93000 EXA Scale™ QX Test Head for AI and HPC Devices
items.summary: Advantest Corporation has launched the V93000 EXA Scale™ QX test head, expanding its SoC test platform to support the increasing demands of AI and high-performance computing.

items.headline: Vicore Pharma to Participate in the DNB Carnegie Nordic Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Vicore Pharma announced its participation in the upcoming DNB Carnegie Nordic Healthcare Conference in Oslo, Norway.

items.headline: Malaysia and France Announce Defense Cooperation and Helicopter Procurement
items.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced plans for enhanced defense cooperation with Malaysia, including the procurement of combat search-and-rescue helicopters from Airbus.

items.headline: Thomas Saueressig to Become CEO of IONOS Group SE
items.summary: United Internet AG announced that Thomas Saueressig will succeed Achim Weiß as CEO of its subsidiary IONOS Group SE effective April 1, 2027.

items.headline: Three Ontario Hospitals Adopt Sectra One Cloud for Pathology and Radiology
items.summary: Three member hospitals of the ENHANCE Ontario network have selected Sectra's cloud-based platform to integrate their pathology and radiology services.

items.headline: SAP Chief Customer Officer Thomas Saueressig to Leave Executive Board
items.summary: SAP SE announced that Thomas Saueressig, a member of the Executive Board and Chief Customer Officer, will depart the company by the end of March 2027.

items.headline: UBS Group AG Notifies Solar A/S of Major Shareholder Position Change
items.summary: UBS Group AG has notified Danish sourcing and services company Solar A/S of a change in its shareholding position, now representing 5.01% of the company's B shares.

items.headline: Visa and Samsung Electronics Launch 'Scan to Pay' on Samsung Wallet in Asia Pacific
items.summary: Visa and Samsung Electronics have partnered to introduce 'Visa Scan to Pay' on Samsung Wallet, allowing users to make QR-based payments with Visa cards on Galaxy devices.

items.headline: Roche Secures First U.S. Approval for New Breast-Cancer Pill
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Roche's new breast cancer medication, Wilserdly (giredestrant), for use in combination with Novartis's Afinitor.

items.headline: Proximar Seafood Announces 60 Million NOK Capital Raise
items.summary: Proximar Seafood AS plans to raise 60 million NOK through a combination of a new share issuance and a hybrid bond.

items.headline: AcuCort Files New Drug Application for Zeqmelit in the US
items.summary: AcuCort has submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) to the FDA for its lead product, Zeqmelit, marking a significant step toward potential commercialization in the United States.

items.headline: Ambromobiliare Acts as Advisor for Orange Media's Euronext Growth Milan Debut
items.summary: Ambromobiliare served as an advisor for the initial public offering and market debut of Orange Media on the Euronext Growth Milan (EGM) exchange.

items.headline: Marley Spoon Group SE Announces Supervisory Board Changes
items.summary: Marley Spoon Group SE reported the resignation of Dr. Ralph Kudla as chairman of the Supervisory Board and the appointment of his successor.

items.headline: M.W. Trade S.A. Subsidiary Sigma Defence S.A. Expands into Defense Sector
items.summary: M.W. Trade S.A. announced that its subsidiary, Sigma Defence S.A., has decided to expand its operations into the development and production of land transport systems for the defense sector, as well as

items.headline: Biofrigas Releases New Video Interview with CEO and New Board Member
items.summary: Biofrigas Sweden AB released a video interview featuring CEO Erik Fromell and new board member Roger Göthberg discussing the company's market potential and commercial strategy.

items.headline: Gambero Rosso Presents 'Le migliori Pasticcerie d'Italia 2027' Guide
items.summary: Gambero Rosso held an event at Palazzo di Varignana to present its latest culinary publication, 'Le migliori Pasticcerie d'Italia 2027'.

items.headline: Innok Robotics Group AG Evaluates Potential Capital Increase
items.summary: Innok Robotics Group AG, which completed a reverse IPO via Yggdrasil SPAC 1 AG, is currently evaluating a potential cash capital increase to support further growth.
